title.narrative: Support towards the training of Medical Specialists and Biomedical Engineering Technicians

description.narrative: This activity Support towards the training of Medical Specialists and Biomedical Engineering Technicians is a component of Human Resources for Health Programme-Phase II reported by FCDO with a funding type of 111 - Not for profit organisation and a budget of £1,997,337. It works in the following sector(s): Health personnel development, Health policy and administrative management.

mailing-address.narrative: Public Enquiry Point, Abercrombie House, Eaglesham Road, East Kilbride, Glasgow G75 8EA
